cloudflare._comment: Two optional secrets prompted at deploy time. Both let the in-app `Lock it down` wizard at /app#/settings short-circuit to a one-click action. Skipping both still works — the wizard just asks for them later. Other optional secrets (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, etc.) are added post-deploy via dash → Worker → Settings → Variables.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: **Optional.** Pre-fills the in-app `Lock it down` wizard at /app#/settings so you don't have to paste a token there later. Create one with these four scopes — [Workers Scripts:Edit, Access: Apps and Policies:Edit, Account Settings:Read, User Details:Read] — at [dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens). Skip if you'd rather paste it in the wizard.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: **Optional.** Your email address. The `Lock it down` wizard pre-fills this as the only email Cloudflare Access will let through. Leave blank to type it in the wizard later. Also used by the email plugin for outbound notifications.
